title: Sneaky Punks
style: Phonk with a mid-tempo four-on-the-floor pulse, swung cowbell snaps, gritty sub-bass, and syncopated drum breaks; intro opens half-whispered over filtered percussion, verses stay sparse with close-mic lead and low gang ad-libs, pre-chorus tightens with rising tension and doubled phrases, chorus lands wider with stacked chants and short delay throws on the anchor. Ear candy includes reverse swells, tape-stop dips, and a brief piano break before the final hook. Dark, punchy, and wet with room grit., low, dynamic, loud, glitch, clean
lyrics:
[Intro]
Sneaky Phonk Panther
Yeah…
Cowbell tapping…
Systems sleeping…
We already inside
Sneaky Punks…
You don’t see us coming

[Chorus]
We move quiet, we move slick
Bass in the floor, cowbell click
You look left, we already right
Data gone missing in the night
Sneaky Punks! (where we at?)
Sneaky Punks! (you can’t catch)
Sneaky Punks! (already gone)
Left the trawler singing on

[Verse 1]
Came through the backdoor, left it cracked
Mesh in the dark, you can’t track that
Nginx humming, Git hooks clean
You still searching on the main screen
We don’t fight loud, we don’t need heat
We reroute while you fall asleep
Phonk in the wires, ice in the vein
Panther in the server, dancing through rain
You pay the stack, we build for free
VDS rising while you watch the feed
We don’t comply, we don’t debate
We just smile when the glitch activate

[Pre-Chorus]
You want control? That’s cute, that’s funny
We already moved it while you count your money
You want the data? Come find the thread
We already stitched it somewhere else instead

[Chorus]
We move quiet, we move slick
Bass in the floor, cowbell click
You look left, we already right
Data gone missing in the night
Sneaky Punks! (where we at?)
Sneaky Punks! (you can’t catch)
Sneaky Punks! (already gone)
Left the trawler singing on

[Verse 2]
Hawk Eye laughing from the rooftop view
Inspector in the mansion, threads coming through
We the ones creeping when the lights go dim
Phonk Panther gang, we don’t need to win
We already winning while you argue terms
We reroute while the big boys squirm
No big speeches, no grandstand play
Just cowbell tapping and we on our way
You built the cage, we found the crack
Now the data’s ours and we ain’t coming back

[Bridge]
Shhh…
Don’t wake the system
We just borrowed what was never yours
Cowbell still tapping…
See you in the next port

[Final Chorus]
We move quiet, we move slick
Bass in the floor, cowbell click
You look left, we already right
Data gone missing in the night
Sneaky Punks! (where we at?)
Sneaky Punks! (you can’t catch)
Sneaky Punks! (already gone)
Left the trawler singing on

[Outro]
Yeah…
We don’t leave trails
We just leave bass
Sneaky Punks…
See you when we see you
